command:
set -eu
before_inode=$(stat -c %i /var/log/inventory/app.log)
marker=$(date +%s)
sh -c 'exec 3>>/var/log/inventory/app.log; printf "writer-before-%s\\n" "$1" >&3; sleep 3; printf "writer-after-%s\\n" "$1" >&3' sh "$marker" &
writer_pid=$!
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    grep -q "writer-before-$marker" /var/log/inventory/app.log && break
    sleep 1
done
grep -q "writer-before-$marker" /var/log/inventory/app.log
logrotate --force --state /tmp/inventory-app-test.state /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-app
wait "$writer_pid"
after_inode=$(stat -c %i /var/log/inventory/app.log)
printf 'inode_before=%s inode_after=%s\n' "$before_inode" "$after_inode"
printf '%s\n' '--- active log ---'
tail -10 /var/log/inventory/app.log
printf '%s\n' '--- compressed rotation ---'
ls -l /var/log/inventory/app.log.1.gz
gzip -t /var/log/inventory/app.log.1.gz
gzip -cd /var/log/inventory/app.log.1.gz | tail -10
[ "$before_inode" = "$after_inode" ]
grep -q "writer-after-$marker" /var/log/inventory/app.log
gzip -cd /var/log/inventory/app.log.1.gz | grep -q "writer-before-$marker"
printf 'verification=PASS marker=%s\n' "$marker"

set -eu
for n in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; do
    printf 'retention-cycle-%s\n' "$n" >> /var/log/inventory/app.log
    logrotate --force --state /tmp/inventory-app-retention.state /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-app

printf 'post-retention-active-write\n' >> /var/log/inventory/app.log
printf '%s\n' '--- retained archives ---'
find /var/log/inventory -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'app.log.*.gz' -printf '%f\n' | sort -V
archive_count=$(find /var/log/inventory -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'app.log.*.gz' | wc -l)
printf 'archive_count=%s\n' "$archive_count"
[ "$archive_count" -eq 7 ]
for f in /var/log/inventory/app.log.*.gz; do gzip -t "$f"; done
